reason: The computing substrate is living neural cultures tuned with Optuna hyperparameter search; DQN agents are only comparison baselines.
H-CAST is a ViT-based CAST model trained with hierarchical losses; CLIP and BioCLIP are only evaluated as comparisons.
RegimeFlow combines conditional flow matching, a Mamba state-space backbone and Bayesian linear regression priors; transformer forecasters are baselines.
The authors train a transformer fMRI encoder aligned to frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings and feed it to the pretrained LLM Shikra for captioning.
The reward and Beta-prior models are transformers trained by the authors, and the method is also applied to LLM fine-tuning.
The benchmarked models reimplemented and trained are CPA, SAMS-VAE, latent additive and decoder-only autoencoder-style networks.
Task Singular Vectors merges fine-tuned CLIP ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16 and ViT-L/14 visual encoders.
The pipeline trains YOLOv8 detection and pose models and uses SAM 2 and video foundation-model features, but their families are not named.
ViT-S/16 image encoders are pretrained and fine-tuned with MLP projectors, using scVI (VAE) and scGPT (transformer) cell-line embeddings; the graph is only a regularization loss.
ProLearn trains a language-guided U-Net and builds its prototype space with the BioMedCLIP vision-language encoder.
xRIR uses a vision transformer on panorama depth maps and MLPs on sinusoidally encoded positions.
GENEB probes frozen embeddings of 40 genomic foundation models (transformer encoders/decoders, Mamba, StripedHyena) with logistic regression.
Lfp2vec continues pretraining the audio-pretrained wav2vec 2.0 transformer on LFP, and regions are decoded with a multilayer perceptron.
ADMN finetunes LayerDrop ViT backbones with a transformer fusion encoder and trains a controller with autoencoder-based initialization.
AdaST uses multi-head temporal attention together with a learned spatial mixer and embedding-based experts.
Progressor is a ResNet34 encoder with fully connected MLP heads predicting Gaussian progress parameters.
DIGGED trains an autoencoder with a Transformer decoder over grammar-derived sequences; DAGNN appears only in an ablation.
NOMAE pretrains a PTv3 sparse transformer encoder with a sparse convolution occupancy decoder.
DARE trains an energy-guided diffusion behavior model and instantiates it on Cal-QL and IQL actor-critic networks.
MindSimulator uses frozen CLIP ViT-L/14, an MLP/residual fMRI autoencoder with a ridge-regression layer, and a diffusion estimator built from 6 Transformer blocks.
